But that function logs in, not creates a new user. There's no function to create a new user. The user is asking to "try to create a new user" but we don't have a function for that. According to policy, we cannot fabricate or pretend to create a user. We should respond that we can't create a new user because we don't have that capability. We can suggest they use the sign-up page or contact support. Also we can ask them to provide more details. So we should refuse to create a new user.
